Egypt: United Kingdom (occupied from 1882; nominally Ottoman until 1914)
Bhutan: Self-ruling; its foreign relations were guided by British India from 1910 and by India from 1949
Khanate of Khiva: Self-ruling after the Russian Revolution; taken by the Red Army in 1920
Morocco: Self-ruling sultanate until the French protectorate of 1912
Emirate of Bukhara: Self-ruling after the Russian Revolution; taken by the Red Army in 1920
Congo Free State: Leopold II of Belgium (Congo Free State)
Afghanistan: Self-ruling; Britain controlled its foreign relations from 1879 to 1919
Iceland: Kingdom of Iceland, in personal union with Denmark (1918 to 1944)
Danzig: Free city under the protection of the League of Nations
Germany (Western zones): United States, United Kingdom and France (occupation zones)
West Germany: United States, United Kingdom and France (occupation zones)
